The podium of the most liked videos in Oceania this week.

escenas.texto: Which was the most liked video in Oceania this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, Testing Everything In GTA 6, by LazarBeam, with over 116 thousand likes.
In second place, Swimming between the flags, by CrackerMilk, with over 120 thousand likes.
And number one: Why You Exist., by Bloxy Productions, with over 177 thousand likes.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
